findings.title: cancel re-enters intake and overwrites a completed session's terminal verdict with cancelled_by_user
findings.recommendation: In SessionBindings#intake, before cancellation_update, refuse (typed) when the stored session already carries a satisfied terminal reason; or route the cancel through SessionDeliberation#cancelled?'s existing predicate instead of a second unguarded spelling of the same rule.

findings.title: The session half of the F07-REL-01 claim-starvation boundary is undocumented and untested; no session-layer progress contract exists
findings.recommendation: No code change at the session seam: keep the early-turn deferral, and record in documentation/architecture/invariants.md that a valid queued control request for the open occurrence must stay claimable regardless of deferral backlog. The code fix stays where F07-REL-01 put it (RequestInboxClaimer#candidate_rows), which is the single decision point both run_next and the CLI ride. Optionally surface a deferred/backlog counter in SessionContextControls#usage_report.

findings.title: The session stores a profile authority binding it never re-verifies; guard_state! checks graph/skill/MCP/egress/behavior only
findings.recommendation: Add enforce_profile_binding! beside enforce_skill_binding! in session.rb (compare record.fetch("profile_digest", LEGACY_PROFILE_DIGEST) against @profile&.canonical_digest) and call it from guard_state! and from view/outcome exactly as enforce_graph_binding! is called. Sequence with whoever closes F21-SEC-01/F25-SEC-01 so all three sites share one verdict.

findings.title: continue on a completed thread terminal-fails the request as stale but returns the completed view with exit 0
findings.recommendation: At cli.rb:249-255, surface the stale terminal-failure instead of returning the view; the mechanism already exists in advance_queued_request/render_request_terminal_failure.

findings.title: Session#recover acts on a paused thread without the absence-of-interrupts precondition that resume enforces
findings.recommendation: At session.rb:330-338, mirror the guard resume already has: read view and refuse (typed) when view.status == :paused && !view.interrupts.empty?, pointing the caller at resume.

findings.title: The bound transcript length in a compact context_control record is measured outside the writer fence while the pinned summary is read back from the record
findings.recommendation: Move the conversation_history_for(thread) read inside the fields lambda at session_context_controls.rb:151 so truncated_fragments and the pinned summary are measured under the same fence.

findings.recommendation: Flip IMPLEMENTATION.md:32 to done with a note pointing at 021-session.md:31-48. Documentation-only, one line.
